items.name: Sports & Active Nutrition Summit Europe 2026
items.to_check: Programme filed from Nathan's screenshots of the event app (11:39-11:40, 9 Nov): the opening before 09:05, the 10:55-11:20 slot, 15:30-16:00, and any other Affiliation Hub breakouts were not in the screenshots. Breaks (refreshments 10:25-10:55, lunch 12:25-13:15) are not filed. Whether the Nutra Healthspan Summit days (10-11 Nov) are covered as their own event.
items.description: NutraIngredients' one-day sports and active nutrition conference, followed on 10 and 11 November by its Nutra Healthspan Summit at the same venue. Programme tracks: State of the Market, Fuelling Performance, Reconsidering Recovery, Weight Management; main room the Partnership Forum, breakouts in Affiliation Hubs.

items.name: Remedy Nutrafood CDMO Conference 2026
items.to_check: Dates are from a NutraIngredients report (22-23 October 2026), not confirmed by Nathan; city and venue of this edition (the first edition, April 2025, was in Gdansk), the programme, who attended for Vita Actives, and Nathan's slides, notes and contacts still to come.
items.added_by: Claude (from Nathan, 9 Nov 2026, and a NutraIngredients report of 3 Nov 2026)
items.description: A conference bringing local contract manufacturers (CDMOs) together with market innovators, run by the nutraceuticals consultancy Remedy. Launched in Gdansk in April 2025 (about 150 attendees), with a satellite event in Riga in June 2026; the 2026 edition ran on 22-23 October. Nathan attended and will share details.
